samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable width and depth.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="waddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write address register.</register>
        <register id="raddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read address register.</register>
        <register id="wptr" width_description="[$clog2(DEPTH):0]">Write pointer.</register>
        <register id="rptr" width_description="[$clog2(DEPTH):0]">Read pointer.</register>
        <register id="wptr_buff" width_description="[$clog2(DEPTH):0]">Write pointer buffer.</register>
        <register id="rptr_buff" width_description="[$clog2(DEPTH):0]">Read pointer buffer.</register>
        <wire id="wen" width_description="1">Write enable signal.</wire>
        <wire id="ren" width_description="1">Read enable signal.</wire>
        <wire id="wfull_reg" width_description="1">Write full register.</wire>
        <wire id="rempty_reg" width_description="1">Read empty register.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Instantiate dual-port RAM
        <submodule id="dual_port_RAM">
            <input id="wclk"/>
            <input id="wenc"/>
            <input id="waddr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
            <input id="wdata" width_description="WIDTH"/>
            <input id="rclk"/>
            <input id="renc"/>
            <input id="raddr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
            <output id="rdata" width_description="WIDTH"/>
        </submodule>

        // Write pointer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull_reg) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                wptr <= {~wptr[0], wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
            end
        end

        // Read pointer logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty_reg) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                rptr <= {~rptr[0], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]};
            end
        end

        // Pointer buffer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        // Full and empty signals
        assign wfull_reg = (wptr == {~rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)], rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:1]});
        assign rempty_reg = (rptr == wptr);

        // Connect to dual-port RAM
        assign wen = winc && !wfull_reg;
        assign ren = rinc && !rempty_reg;

        assign wdata[wdata'high:0] = wdata[wdata'high:0];
        assign rdata[rdata'high:0] = dual_port_RAM.rdata[dual_port_RAM.rdata'high:0];

        // Assign outputs
        assign wfull = wfull_reg;
        assign rempty = rempty_reg;
        assign rdata[rdata'high:0] = dual_port_RAM.rdata[dual_port_RAM.rdata'high:0];
    </implementation>
</module>
